verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's docs say it groups incoming monitoring alerts into cases, and alert disposition is marketed, so the core 'group into an investigation' element is first-party. CRM person profiles show subjects exist as objects, but nothing documents grouping subjects and transactions into a case. Missing for 10: alert prioritization or scoring, explicit grouping of subjects and transactions into a case, in-depth UI documentation of investigation assembly, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can prioritize alerts and group relevant subjects and transactions into an investigation

citations.quote: Hummingbird will group alerts into cases
Screen customers and disposition alerts more intelligently.
Hummingbird allows you to associate files with CRM objects.
